Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding a portion of state route number 7 from the scenic system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excluding a portion of state route number 7 fromthe scenic system; and amending RCW 47.42.025.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.42.025 and 1971 ex.s. c 62 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following sections of the scenic and recreational highwaysystem are excluded from the scenic system as defined in subsection (7)of RCW 47.42.020: (1) Beginning on state route number 101 at the junction withAirport Road north of Shelton, thence north to a point two thousandfeet north of Airport Road. (2) Beginning on state route number 101 at the junction with MillCreek Road south of Forks, thence north two and fourtenths miles tothe Calawah River bridge. (3) Beginning on state route number 105 at a point onehalf milesouthwest of the boundary of Aberdeen, thence northeast to the boundaryof Aberdeen. (4) Beginning on state route number 17 at a point ninetenths of a p. 1 HB 3333mile west of Grape Drive in the vicinity of Moses Lake, thence easterlyto a junction of Grape Drive. (5) Beginning on state route number 12 at a point onehalf milesouth of the south boundary of Dayton, thence northerly to the southboundary of Dayton. (6) Beginning on state route number 14 onehalf mile west of thewest boundary of Bingen, thence east to a point onehalf mile east ofthe east boundary of Bingen. (7) Beginning on state route number 7 at the junction with 276thstreet east south of Spanaway, thence north to the junction with 224thstreet east.
